name: border-beam
title: Border Beam
description: Animated border beam effect for cards and surfaces

changelog.summary: Internal refactor: derived render-phase state replaces sync effects; no API change.

props.name: size
props.description: Chooses the beam motion family and sizing preset.

props.name: colorVariant
props.description: Chooses the color palette used by the beam.

props.name: theme
props.description: Sets the light, dark, or system-aware beam tuning.

props.name: active
props.description: Turns the beam animation on or off.

props.name: duration
props.description: Time for the beam to complete a loop.

props.name: beamWidth
props.description: Thickness of the animated border beam.
